'''Textrcryonoodle Sa''' operated in [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]. A [[Color|white]] sign spelled out its name in mirror-inverted [[Aurebesh]], with the first part of the name being vertical, and the second part being horizontal. Another sign was green, but showed every letter upside-down.<ref name="Kenobi" />
